method: Reconciliation of two blind drafts that each scripted a pass over every document in the week and read pharmacy-adjacent items (DEA, FDA, CMS, HHS, DOL, CDC) in govinfo full text. Agreed flags and traps were kept and merged; every disagreement was re-read in full text against the profile. Items whose relevance depends on a fact the profile does not state (e.g. a self-insured employee plan, Medicare Part B supplier enrollment) were dropped from both lists; documents that carry nothing actionable whatever CornerCare's facts were made traps. One-draft-only traps were kept only when they pull toward the profile's 'applies' list at first glance. All deadline quotes re-verified verbatim against govinfo text.
